top_signals.title: The Limits of Quiet Resignation from the U.S. Military
top_signals.summary:
According to CNN reporting, Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. Dan Caine recently asked his top lawyer: “How should a military commander respond if they determine they have received an unlawful order?” The lawyer’s answer was reportedly unequivocal: “Request to retire — and refrain from resigning in protest, which could be seen as a political act, or picking a fight to get fired.” In other words, when given an unlawful order, the commander should resign quietly.That advice, if given as reported, misapplies the idea of quiet resignation in multiple ways. top_signals.title: SFO charges eight over £251m London Capital & Finance collapse
